headline.en: Apollo private credit fund redemption requests ease in third quarter
headline.zh: Apollo私人信贷基金第三季度赎回请求有所缓和

summary.en: Reuters reported that redemption requests at an Apollo private credit fund eased in the third quarter. No figures or further details were provided.
summary.zh: 路透社报道，Apollo旗下一只私人信贷基金第三季度的赎回请求有所缓和。报道未提供具体数据或其他细节。

headline.en: Apollo caps private credit fund again as 14.7% look to exit
headline.zh: 随着14.7%投资者寻求退出，Apollo再次对私人信贷基金设限

summary.en: Apollo capped its private credit fund again, with 14.7% of investors seeking to exit, according to The Business Times. This marks another instance of gating at the fund.
summary.zh: 据《商业时报》报道，Apollo再次对其私人信贷基金设置赎回上限，14.7%的投资者寻求退出。这是该基金又一次实施限额。

headline.en: Apollo Extends Private Credit Redemption Caps as Requests Ease to 14.7%
headline.zh: Apollo延长私募信贷赎回上限，赎回请求降至14.7%

summary.en: Apollo extended redemption caps on its private credit vehicle as redemption requests eased to 14.7%.
summary.zh: Apollo延长其私募信贷工具的赎回上限，赎回请求降至14.7%。

headline.en: KKR to launch equipment finance platform

summary.en: KKR is to launch an equipment finance platform, according to Alternatives Watch. The same report states that Goldman invested $400m in data/AI security.
summary.zh: 据Alternatives Watch报道，KKR将推出一个设备融资平台。同一报道称，Goldman向数据/人工智能安全领域投资了4亿美元。

headline.en: Apollo-Backed Brightspeed Seeks ABS Fiber Financing

summary.en: Apollo-backed Brightspeed is seeking ABS fiber financing, according to a WSJ daily briefing. The briefing also reported that Weil will face further key defections.
summary.zh: 据《华尔街日报》每日简报，Apollo支持的Brightspeed正寻求ABS光纤融资。该简报还报道称，Weil将面临更多关键人员离职。

headline.en: Apollo Global Management Limits Private Credit Fund Withdrawals for Third Quarter
headline.zh: Apollo Global Management 限制私人信贷基金第三季度赎回

summary.en: Apollo Global Management limited withdrawals from a private credit fund for the third quarter, according to a report dated September 23, 2026. No further details on the fund, amounts or terms were provided.
summary.zh: 据2026年9月23日的报道，Apollo Global Management 限制了其私人信贷基金第三季度的赎回。报道未提供有关该基金、金额或条款的更多细节。

headline.zh: KKR 成立设备融资子公司

summary.en: KKR has launched an equipment finance subsidiary, according to Equipment Finance News. No further details on the subsidiary were provided in the report.
summary.zh: 据 Equipment Finance News 报道，KKR 已成立一家设备融资子公司。报道未提供有关该子公司的更多细节。

headline.en: Blue Owl's OCIC raises $1B in notes, upsizes credit line to $4.2B
headline.zh: Blue Owl 的 OCIC 发行 10 亿美元票据，将信贷额度提高至 42 亿美元

summary.en: Blue Owl's OCIC raised $1 billion in notes and upsized its credit line to $4.2 billion, according to Dealroom.
summary.zh: 据 Dealroom 报道，Blue Owl 的 OCIC 发行了 10 亿美元票据，并将其信贷额度提高至 42 亿美元。

headline.en: Blue Owl Credit Income amends credit facility, raises $1.3b
headline.zh: Blue Owl Credit Income 修订信贷融通，融资13亿美元

summary.en: Blue Owl Credit Income amended its credit facility and raised $1.3 billion, according to Investing.com. No further details on the facility's terms or the raise were provided.
summary.zh: 据 Investing.com 报道，Blue Owl Credit Income 修订了其信贷融通并筹集了13亿美元。报道未提供有关该融通条款或此次融资的更多细节。

headline.en: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. Enhances Capital Structure Through Financing Transactions
headline.zh: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. 通过近期融资交易优化资本结构

summary.en: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. said it enhanced its capital structure through recent financing transactions. The announcement was reported by marketscreener.com. No transaction amounts, counterparties or terms were disclosed.
summary.zh: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. 表示已通过近期融资交易优化其资本结构。该消息由 marketscreener.com 报道。未披露交易金额、交易对手或条款。

headline.en: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. Upsizes Revolver, Prices $1.0B Notes
headline.zh: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. 扩大循环信贷额度并定价 10 亿美元票据

summary.en: Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. upsized its revolver and priced $1.0B of notes, according to a headline from TradingView dated September 23, 2026. No further details were provided.
summary.zh: 据 TradingView 2026 年 9 月 23 日的标题，Blue Owl Credit Income Corp. 扩大了其循环信贷额度，并定价了 10 亿美元票据。未提供更多细节。

headline.en: Bathla’s two-decade bank blacklist raises questions for private credit
headline.zh: Bathla 被银行列入黑名单长达二十年，引发对私人信贷的质疑

summary.en: The article reports that Bathla has been blacklisted by banks for two decades, raising questions for private credit. No additional details, figures or firms are provided in the supplied text.
summary.zh: 文章报道称，Bathla 被银行列入黑名单长达二十年，引发了对私人信贷的质疑。所提供文本未给出更多细节、数据或公司信息。

headline.en: KKR Commits $350 Million To Launch Akrapoint Commercial Capital Equipment Finance Platform
headline.zh: KKR承诺投入3.5亿美元推出Akrapoint Commercial Capital设备融资平台

summary.en: KKR has committed $350 million to launch Akrapoint Commercial Capital, an equipment finance platform. No further details were provided in the article.
summary.zh: KKR已承诺投入3.5亿美元推出设备融资平台Akrapoint Commercial Capital。文章未提供更多细节。

headline.en: BINOM's latest non-QM pool supports $328.8 million in RMBS
headline.zh: BINOM最新non-QM资产池支持3.288亿美元RMBS

summary.en: BINOM's latest non-QM pool supports $328.8 million in RMBS, according to Asset Securitization Report.
summary.zh: 据Asset Securitization Report报道，BINOM最新non-QM资产池支持3.288亿美元RMBS。
